# `src/translation.x`

> in any release.

### translate_print_command

`void translate_print_command(CliRequest request, String out_dir, List inputs)`

Prints the translate command that writes `inputs` to `out_dir`, as
verbose and dry-run requests show it, quoted as a dry-run tool action
prints its arguments.

Source: `src/translation.x`

### translate_request

`int translate_request(CliRequest request, Map unit_dirs, void *context, void (*progress)(void *context, String input, int completed))`

Translates a request synchronously. Optional per-input directories and a
parent-process progress callback let a caller own build state. Without a
callback, translation reports its own progress and receipt.

Source: `src/translation.x`

## Design notes

One request's units share a frontend. `unit_dirs` maps each input to its
own output directory on the build path, where the caller reports progress;
`x2c translate` has neither.
